# Code of conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
It applies in the project's issues, pull requests and anywhere else you represent the project.

In short: be respectful, assume good faith, and keep criticism on the work. Harassment, personal attacks and
publishing someone's private information aren't accepted.

## Reporting a problem

Contact the maintainer, [Adombs](https://github.com/adombs), at the address on their GitHub profile. Reports are kept
private. The maintainer may edit or remove comments, and may block anyone who breaks these rules.
